result.reason: The clause reaches the preferred position: Corio may terminate on 30 days’ written notice without an early-termination charge and receives a pro-rata refund, while Commerce One has no convenience-termination right during a committed term. However, “in whole or in part” unnecessarily grants a partial-termination right not required by the playbook and could disrupt bundled scope or pricing. Deleting that phrase would make the change appropriately limited while preserving the existing commercial structure.
